items.title: Kristen Korb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: The transcript shows Monk Rowe is the interviewer and Kristen Korb is the interviewee. There is no mention of any prior personal or professional relationship between them in the provided text.

ctx.x: Kristen was interviewed in Scottsdale, Arizona on April 16, 2000, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Scottsdale, Arizona filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m quite pleased to have a young, up-and-coming jazz star, Kristen Korb, bassist, and you made quite an impression here at the festival so far.
